record.question: The Union government has planned to build a "Statue of Unity" in Gujarat. This will be a statue of
record.explanation: Answer C: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel. The Statue of Unity represents Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel. The Gujarat district authority and Government of India location record identify the subject of the monument. Historical/source note: Question describes the project before completion; no claim that it remains only planned today. Reference: https://narmada.nic.in/tourist-place/statue-of-unity-kevadia/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
